releases.name: Scritchy Scratchy
releases.summary: Cute kitties want to get across the river, but bridge had been broken. Now only you can help cats get to the other side. Don't let them fall into the water, catch bonuses and have score as high as possible!

releases.name: Missed Class: Horror
releases.summary:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape
releases.summary: * The Question Game!* Currently for free!* Have fun and get to know your fellow players by asking daring questions!A Question Game is an awesome game where you get to know your family, friends, lover or party crowd. Find out about their biggest dreams, craziest adventures or intimate secrets. Add great question list for different occasions, like party guests or flirting.Features:* Ask your favorite questions on facebook or twitter* Mail or message questions to friends* Save favourite questions for the next game

releases.name: Fallen City Brawl
releases.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

releases.name: EA Sports FC 27
releases.summary:
Step into The Grounds, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch. Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations. Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club. Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players. [EA Sports]

releases.name: Angle Of Attack
releases.summary: Check out this fun and addictive time based fruit matching game.Match 3 or more fruits in a row to eliminate and score higher before time runs out. Fun for all ages.Try it out for today!

releases.name: Stock Cars Racing
releases.summary: Pilot your rocket-powered locomotive into battle against the drone armies. The subway tracks are the only way in and you are the city's last hope!? Race against your friends to see who can make it the farthest!? Unlock new trains with new weapons!? Watch out for the boss drones—they're hard to kill but easily kill you!

releases.name: Sandwalkers
releases.summary:
Every decade, the Mka tribe sends caravans of adventurers into the Phithi, the meteorological chaos that keeps the Uwando tribes isolated from each other and makes life outside the refuges almost impossible.

Their mission: to establish diplomatic and trade relations, to explore and reclaim the lands left to the mercy of monsters and pirates, and, most importantly, to plant a new tree city that can become a refuge for the Mka and their allies. 

Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based exploration game. Build your team, traverse varied hostile environments, face countless dangers, and gain knowledge that will help you find and resurrect the Mother Tree Umama.

releases.name: SiN: Reloaded
releases.summary:
From Nightdive Studios, SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits.

Enter a near-future dystopian world as security consultant Colonel John R. Blade as you take on the seductively evil Doctor Elexis Sinclaire. When Elexis, the CEO of SinTEK Industries, begins injecting the streets with a DNA-altering drug, it's time to reassess the laws of morality. 

As Blade, you've made a religion out of fighting crime. Now you're going to make Elexis pay for her sins by taking on her unholy army of genetically-engineered mutants.

releases.name: Farming Camp
releases.summary:
Farming Camp is a cozy, single-player farm management game that follows the journey of an ambitious teenager competing to become the best farmer in the camp. Manage your farm alongside your companions, complete chores for points, and deal with the dynamics of a colorful cast in their teenage years.

Step into the boots of young Alessandra, before she became the renowned Evertree Farmer. Experience her life at the Evertree Farming Camp where it all began. Learn the ropes and face the fun and chaos of camp life.

You're not alone on the farm. You’ll have the company of two budding young farmers, each with their own vibe. Assign chores, solve problems, and build friendships as you figure out how to run the farm together.

releases.name: Kalanoro
releases.summary:
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause! 

Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny! 

Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island! 

Assemble a band of eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games, and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.

releases.name: Garfield: Escape from Monday
releases.summary:
Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

When you’re a lazy cat spending most of his time sleeping, having a nightmare can happen. But a nightmare full of vegetables and sugar-free candies, no way!

After Jon fed him spinach lasagnas inspired by Chef Monday’s recipe, Garfield falls into a deep sleep...

To wake up and reactivate his taste buds, the laziest cat in the world will have to explore worlds filled with enemies and eat a gigantic deal of lasagnas!

Fortunately Garfield can rely on Jon and his friends Odie, Arlene and Pookie. But also on his turkey, surfer and cowboy suits that will give him amazing skills!

- Move like a cat
Jump, climb the walls, curl up into a ball… you will always land on your feet!

- Embody Garfield in every form
Go airborne dressed as a turkey, slide on the water like a surfer and swing with your cowboy lasso!

- All the Garfield cast is here
Jon will be here to help you in your quest, along with Odie and Pookie. But beware Garfield's archenemies, Nermal and Squeak!

- Explore lively worlds
3 worlds and dozens of levels filled with enemies to fight and lasagnas to devour to regain the taste.

- The more you eat, the more rooms you edit!
Gather tons of delicious collectibles to keep your morale and help refurbish Jon's house with all kinds of surprising items.

releases.name: Superstar Strategy
releases.summary:
Outfight and outwit your enemies in this turn-based tactics game. Use each unit's unique abilities and the terrain around you to your advantage to thwart your opponent's plans and reign supreme!

Push, pull, teleport, and displace your enemies onto traps to deal additional damage and apply status effects between rounds. If you are able to escape the trap before the new round starts, you can cheat fate!

With 14 different unit roles to choose from, you can create your own unique combinations to build your own personal army! Experiment with different units to find synergies and force multipliers to improve your chances of victory.

releases.name: What Was Here? 1-Minute Memory Quiz!!
releases.summary:
Look, memorize, choose! What tiny item was hidden? Quick brain training!

How much of a picture can you remember after just one minute?

This is a memory quiz where you study an illustration first, then answer a 4-choice question about what was in the hidden spot.
The rules are simple: just pick an answer and jump right in.

How to play:

・Memorize the small items and layout before time runs out
・Check the spot that has been covered
・Choose which small item was there from 4 options

Can you remember a spot you only glanced at?
Each quick question tests your observation and memory at a snappy pace.

Because each round is short, it is great for a quick break or a little brain training in your spare time.
Think it through solo, or gather family and friends around the screen and talk through the answer together.
